description_text: Amendment Posted 4/16/2026. The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, materials, supervision, and otheritems and non-personal services necessary to support the leased climate-controlled tent structuresrequirements of the 84th TC and the 78th TD as defined in this PWS.
